routers.rule:
Routers should define routes and connect them to controllers.
Routers should contain no business logic.

controllers.rule:
Controllers should validate requests and call services.
Controllers should contain no business logic.

dependencies.rule: Dependency methods should live in their own files.

authorization.rule: For authorization, use Policy classes similar to the policy pattern used by Ruby on Rails.

naming.rule: Use filenames such as _router.py and _controller.py where this convention is adopted by the project.

authentication.rule: When user authentication exists, request.state.user should contain the authenticated user information.

multi_tenancy.rule: When multi-tenancy exists, request.state.tenant should contain the current tenant information.
